description: This is a blueprint for a simple patient medical record document. Its contains the fields - Name, DOB, Sex, Phone, Address, Emergency Contact, Insurance Name, Insurance Coverage Type, Insurance Policy Number, Primary Care Physician, Clinic, Physician notes

DOB.instruction: Date of birth of the patient

Emergency Contact.instruction: Emergency contact information for the patient

Insurance Name.instruction: Name of the patient's insurance provider

Insurance Coverage Type.instruction: Type of insurance coverage the patient has

Insurance Policy Number.instruction: Policy number of the patient's insurance

Primary Care Physician.instruction: Name of the patient's primary care physician

Clinic.instruction: Name of the clinic where the patient's primary care physician is located

Physician Notes.instruction: Notes from the patient's physician, including diagnosis, treatment, and prescription information
